@startuml
!define RECTANGLE class

participant "APIGateway" as APIGateway
participant "Orchestrator" as Orchestrator
participant "Render" as Render
participant "DeviceModel" as DeviceModel
participant "VoltMgmt" as VoltMgmt

APIGateway -> Orchestrator : StartNewVolt Request\n(Shelf:Type, NT:Name,Slot, LT:Name,Slot, ONU:Type,Position,SN...)
activate Orchestrator

Orchestrator -> Render : Render Request\n(With Parameters)
activate Render

Render -> DeviceModel : Get Model of Specific NT/LT\n(Uplink/Downlink Nums, Port Type...)
activate DeviceModel
DeviceModel --> Render : Response\n(Model Info)

deactivate DeviceModel

Render --> Orchestrator : Response\n(values.yaml)
deactivate Render

Orchestrator -> VoltMgmt : StartNewVolt Request\n(With values.yaml)
activate VoltMgmt
VoltMgmt --> Orchestrator : Response\n(Volt ID, Status or Failure Reason)
deactivate VoltMgmt

Orchestrator --> APIGateway : Final Response\n(Volt ID, Status or Failure Reason)
deactivate Orchestrator
@enduml
